name: Exa
title: exa.ai
shortDescription: Exa is an AI-powered search engine designed to enhance the search experience by providing more relevant, context-aware results. It caters to researchers, data analysts, and anyone in need of precise information retrieval. Example use case: A data scientist uses Exa to quickly find datasets for machine learning projects, significantly reducing research time.
